name: The Phantom Icecream Truck
source:
A short horror story in a pseudo Lovecraftian vein.

A detective is hired to investigate the kidnappings of several children.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26023]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

一个伪洛夫克拉夫特风格的恐怖短篇故事。

一名侦探受雇调查几名儿童的绑架案。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26023]引理软论坛[/url]]
